runs.interventionSemantics: Identical attempted events are shadow-replayed. In a separate effect ledger, a BLOCK or failed synthetic challenge holds that account/session; a passed challenge permits the attempt. An earlier hold can prevent a later impact only in that same session. These outcomes are simulated, not counterfactual engine retraining.
runs.classificationSemantics: Unweighted event-level TP/FP/TN/FN for recommendations. BLOCK or STEP_UP_VERIFICATION is positive, including when a challenge passes. Malicious episode action and impact rows are ground-truth positives. Warmup and failed-authentication observation rows are excluded.

runs.memoryStore: local in-process stand-in with read-back verification (not hosted Meko)

analyst.semantics: Each attack impact case is confirmed after the review delay in simulated time. A pattern is usable only after the worker reads it back.
